note: Redrawn board-exam figures, reusable across sittings. Match a new problem to an archetype, copy the SVG, retune labels and dimension values.

figures.archetype: parallel-chord truss, cross-braced panel
figures.caption: Panel CDHI is cross-braced by cables CI and DH. Note the supports: A is the ROLLER, F is the PIN.

figures.archetype: beam on hinge + continuous cable over pulley
figures.caption: One continuous cable over a frictionless pulley at D — the tension is identical in segment BD and segment DC. B is at 3 m, C at 6 m.

figures.archetype: block on inclined plane held by force P
figures.caption: P pushes UP the incline. θ is measured between P and the inclined surface; the plane itself rises 12° from the ground.

figures.archetype: guyed pole, two anchor cables (3-D)
figures.caption: Space frame: pole AB along Z, H applied at A along +Y. The dotted construction lines fix the anchors: C = (b, −a, 0) on the +X side, D = (−c, −d, 0) on the −X side — opposite sides, which is what lets their X-components cancel.

figures.archetype: signage on tubular pole, elevation + top view
figures.caption: H is dimensioned from the ground to the TOP of the signage; L is the signage height. In the top view the signage runs off one side of the pole.

figures.archetype: prism with inclined section a-a under axial P
figures.caption: Plane a-a is inclined at θ = 30° from the Y-axis (the axis of the load).

figures.archetype: two-column bent with inclined member, cases A/B
figures.caption: FIGURE A: both P₁ and P₂ vertical. FIGURE B: P₂ inclined at θ. Members AC and DF are the tubular columns; BE is the wide-flange diagonal.

figures.archetype: beam: fixed + roller + pin
figures.caption: A is FIXED to the wall, B is a roller, C is a pin.

figures.archetype: three-span compound girder with internal hinge
figures.caption: Three equal spans of L with an internal hinge at C. Segment CD hangs off the hinge; ABC carries it as an overhang.

figures.archetype: anchored sheet pile + stringer detail
figures.caption: Anchored sheet pile: soil retained to H₂ on the left, water to H₃ on the right, tension rod near the dredge line, wooden stringers spanning between rods.

figures.archetype: bent cantilever tube, 3-D loads + torque
figures.caption: Cantilever AB (2 × 1.5 m) with a 40 N transverse load, then BC (4 m) inclined at 30° carrying 70 kN and 50 N, plus a 100 N·m torque about the axis of AB.

figures.archetype: double-tee prestressed joist cross-section
figures.caption: Double-tee joist section: flange width b, yₜ to the top fibre, yᵇ to the bottom fibre, two webs each carrying a prestressing strand.

figures.archetype: angle lap-welded to gusset, elevation + side view
figures.caption: Single angle lap-welded to a gusset plate. The weld lengths a (near the heel side) and b are proportioned so their resultant lines up with the angle’s centroid at x̄.

figures.archetype: purlin on sloped truss top chord
figures.caption: Purlin on a sloped top chord: the load resolves into w cosθ normal to the roof (bending about x) and w sinθ along the slope (bending about y).

figures.archetype: column base plate + equivalent bearing section
figures.caption: Column base plate B×N on concrete. The equivalent column section for bearing is 0.95d × 0.8bf; the cantilever overhangs m and n govern plate bending.

figures.archetype: beam deflection / span-limit reference
figures.caption: T-beam at a column support carrying NEGATIVE moment — the flange is in tension, so the compression block sits in the web. Aₛ is the top steel, Aₛ′ the bottom.

figures.archetype: formula reference card
figures.caption: The minimum spiral steel ratio expressions printed with the problem.

figures.archetype: column interaction diagram (source raster)
figures.caption: Interaction diagram for a spiral column, f′_c = 27.5 MPa, f_y = 413 MPa, γ = 0.8. Read Kₙ on the vertical axis against Rₙ on the horizontal.
